description: When the bridge cannot reach Codex App Server it still takes the delivery off the hub queue (`mentions pending` becomes empty) and holds it as `queued` with Actor state `ECONNREFUSED`. The person's board shows the mention comment with no cue that the agent never received it.
expected: The mention shows a waiting/undelivered state (e.g. 'Queued for Setup agent — its Codex session is unreachable'), or Activity surfaces bridge state.
actual: Plain comment; delivery state exists only in `bridge status`.
suggested_fix: Surface per-mention delivery/bridge state in the comment or the agent's profile.

description: After the bridge process is killed (SIGKILL), `bridge status` still reports `bridge: running` and `source: connected`, so an operator checking status believes mentions are being dispatched.
expected: Status checks the inbox storage lease / process liveness and reports `stopped (not running)` or `unknown — last seen at …`.
suggested_fix: Have status probe the storage lease (it can acquire it ⇒ not running) and report observation age.

description: `bridge inspect` and the bridge's Actor state report a raw `ECONNREFUSED: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:9001` when no Codex App Server is listening.
expected: 'Codex App Server is not listening at ws://127.0.0.1:9001; start it with codex app-server --listen ws://127.0.0.1:9001'.
actual: Raw socket error code used as both error code and Actor state.
suggested_fix: Wrap connection failures in a CODEX_UNREACHABLE error with the endpoint and a start hint.

description: A second `bridge run` (or `bridge reconcile`) on an inbox held by a running bridge says 'Another Pardner service is using this storage directory'.
expected: 'Another bridge run is using this inbox; stop it (Ctrl-C) first'.
suggested_fix: Pass a bridge-specific message to the storage lease.
